bio.text: Johnny Garcia won the Democratic primary runoff for Texas's 35th Congressional District on May 26, 2026, defeating Maureen Galindo, according to the Washington Examiner.
The San Antonio Report described him in October 2025 as a veteran deputy with the Bexar County Sheriff's Office and its public information officer when he announced his campaign.

sources.title: Bexar County Deputy Johnny Garcia wages congressional bid
Johnny Garcia wins Texas Democratic runoff election against Maureen Galindo
